beats.direction: Use the recurring witness with an on-screen disclaimer: CITY CONTEXT / NOT DAY-SPECIFIC.
beats.voice: London makes the week visible as a relay among institutional schedule, temporary room, camera, platform, labor, commerce and archive. This chapter follows backstage coordination: The same field that helps a show run—a name, measurement, image, availability or location—can also make labor newly trackable and extractable.
beats.onScreen: Then: The BFC’s 2016 Designer Fashion Fund series documents designers and teams preparing in studios and backstage for London Fashion Week, offering a worker-visible record without proving a week-wide software stack.

beats.direction: Animate only line reveals and state changes in the original evidence diagram.
beats.voice: The BFC’s 2016 Designer Fashion Fund series documents designers and teams preparing in studios and backstage for London Fashion Week, offering a worker-visible record without proving a week-wide software stack. That earlier record fixes a point in time; it does not prove an inevitable progression toward the present.
beats.onScreen: Now: The BFC publicly specifies a dedicated producer and production team for supported NEWGEN showcases, while current public records do not establish a named week-wide casting, measurement or look-tracking platform. The labor layer is verified; the data stack remains unresolved.
beats.credit: Graphic © Rayven-Nikkita Collins; sources in claim ledger

beats.direction: Animate only line reveals and state changes in the original evidence diagram.
beats.voice: The distinction is material. A polished interface can survive after its workers, contracts, specifications or permission trail disappear, leaving the audience with an outcome but not its operating history.
beats.onScreen: Next: The bounded search in G-FUTURE-07 did not establish a biometric or digital-identity deployment; future reporting must include labor, privacy, consent, and model-rights evidence.
